findings.highlight: the students head home one after another.
findings.evidenceJa: 生徒たちは波が引くように下校していった。
findings.governingReading: The students leave school like a wave receding.
findings.explanation: Sequential departure remains, but the visual image of the school draining away disappears.

findings.highlight: the boundary field has its foundations
findings.evidenceJa: 結界を張る為の支えとなる“呪刻”
findings.governingReading: curse marks that serve as supports for establishing the bounded field
findings.explanation: The English obscures 呪刻 as discrete magical inscriptions and makes the field itself vaguely possess “foundations.”

findings.highlight: throughout the school.
findings.evidenceJa: 学校には何カ所か
findings.governingReading: There are curse marks at several specific locations in the school.
findings.explanation: “Throughout” removes the bounded count and distinct anchor points.

findings.highlight: been searching and erasing them
findings.evidenceJa: 何日も前から見つけては消している
findings.governingReading: For many days Rin has repeatedly found and erased the marks.
findings.explanation: The duration of her prior effort is omitted.

findings.highlight: they keep coming back up
findings.evidenceJa: 数日前に消した呪刻が再度浮かび上がったり
findings.governingReading: curse marks erased several days earlier reappear
findings.explanation: The broad recurrence remains, but the concrete prior erasure and multi-day persistence disappear.

findings.highlight: I’m sure the Master won’t activate it until it’s complete.
findings.evidenceJa: 相手だって結界を発動させないでしょ？
findings.governingReading: Rin predicts rhetorically that the opponent probably will not activate an incomplete field.
findings.explanation: “I’m sure” strengthens a tactical expectation into confidence.

findings.highlight: Ohno, this is about a different matter.
findings.evidenceJa: あいや、それとは別件。
findings.governingReading: “Ah, no—this is a separate matter.”
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “Oh” and “no.”

findings.highlight: I can’t feel anything.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の方はここで打ち止めだ
findings.governingReading: For Shirou’s part, this location is the end or limit of what he can detect.
findings.explanation: The English turns a local stopping point into total sensory inability.

findings.highlight: we’ve erased all the active marks now.
findings.evidenceJa: 生きている呪刻はほとんど消せたかな。
findings.governingReading: They may have erased almost all the still-active curse marks.
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes both the small possible remainder and Rin’s tentative かな.

findings.highlight: sensitive to abnormality in the air.
findings.evidenceJa: 場所の異状には敏感
findings.governingReading: sensitive to abnormalities in a place
findings.explanation: The English invents the air as the sensed medium.

findings.highlight: I didn’t think I’d be able to erase all the marks so fast.
findings.evidenceJa: こんなに早く、校舎内の呪刻を消せるとは思わなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin did not expect them to clear the school’s curse marks this quickly with Shirou locating anomalies.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the achievement solely to Rin and again changes the scope to all marks.

findings.highlight: this is no time for that.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はそういう気分じゃない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou is not in the mood to enjoy having helped.
findings.explanation: An emotional state becomes an external time constraint.

findings.highlight: even if their Servant is in spirit form?
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントは隠していても
findings.governingReading: even while the Servant is being concealed
findings.explanation: The English narrows concealment to dematerialization and incorrectly makes that capability part of the general test.

findings.highlight: a great familiar
findings.evidenceJa: 破格の使い魔
findings.governingReading: a familiar of extraordinary, category-breaking scale
findings.explanation: Generic praise loses why a Servant’s contract cannot be hidden normally.

findings.highlight: since you’re slow
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんは鈍感だから
findings.governingReading: because Emiya is insensitive or dull to magical energy
findings.explanation: The English changes perceptual insensitivity into mental or physical slowness.

findings.highlight: I’m sure I can recognize another Master
findings.evidenceJa: わたしだってマスターを見れば識別できるんじゃないかな
findings.governingReading: Rin supposes that she too should be able to identify a Master on sight.
findings.explanation: The tentative じゃないかな becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: Magi approve others as magi
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師って認めないの
findings.governingReading: do not recognize someone as a magus
findings.explanation: “Approve” implies institutional permission rather than classification by detectable magical-energy threshold.

findings.highlight: follow the trail of magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 強い魔力の残り香を辿って
findings.governingReading: follow the lingering scent of strong magical energy
findings.explanation: The English loses both intensity and the sensory after-scent metaphor.

findings.highlight: nobody would find out about them.
findings.evidenceJa: 敵には悟られない
findings.governingReading: the enemy will not perceive them
findings.explanation: The tactical concealment relation becomes universal invisibility to everyone.

findings.highlight: a magical energy as large as a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントのデタラメな魔力
findings.governingReading: a Servant’s absurd or outrageous magical energy
findings.explanation: The English keeps quantity but loses Rin’s evaluative emphasis on its rule-breaking scale.

findings.highlight: a Master even if he’s close to you
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の身近にいる人間
findings.governingReading: a person in Rin’s close social circle
findings.explanation: The English changes a relationship clue into temporary physical proximity.

findings.highlight: can’t identify a Master even when I’m near him
findings.evidenceJa: 身近にいてもマスターかどうか判らない
findings.governingReading: cannot tell that someone close to her is a Master
findings.explanation: The repeated 身近 social premise becomes Rin moving near a man, weakening the concealed-identity inference.

findings.highlight: we eliminated a lot of the marks.
findings.evidenceJa: 大部分の呪刻を消せて
findings.governingReading: they erased the great majority of the curse marks
findings.explanation: “A lot” does not preserve that most anchors are gone.

findings.highlight: because we were so active
findings.evidenceJa: これだけハデに邪魔をされたら
findings.governingReading: after being obstructed this conspicuously and extensively
findings.explanation: The enemy’s experience of deliberate interference becomes the heroes merely being active.

findings.highlight: the enemy coming out in the future
findings.evidenceJa: 近いうちに必ずボロを出す
findings.governingReading: the enemy will inevitably expose a weakness or make a revealing mistake soon
findings.explanation: mirror moon loses certainty, near-term timing, and the prediction of a diagnostic slip.

findings.highlight: won’t just stay quiet if something like this happens.
findings.evidenceJa: 邪魔されて我慢できる性格じゃない
findings.governingReading: The culprit is not the sort who can tolerate being obstructed.
findings.explanation: A character judgment tied to sabotage becomes a generic response to “something.”

findings.highlight: won’t let the same thing happen twice.
findings.evidenceJa: 二度目は黙ってられない性格
findings.governingReading: The culprit’s temperament will not let them remain silent after a second obstruction.
findings.explanation: The English changes an expected retaliatory response into ability to prevent recurrence.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka sneers at the Master we have yet to see.
findings.evidenceJa: ふふん、とまだ見ぬマスターを鼻で笑う。
findings.governingReading: This narration is semicolon-prefixed and inactive in the original Japanese.
findings.explanation: The classic English branch activates obsolete narration that explicitly fixes Rin’s affect.

findings.highlight: in preparation for tomorrow.
findings.evidenceJa: 明日の決戦に備えて
findings.governingReading: to prepare for tomorrow’s decisive battle
findings.explanation: The English deletes what Rin is preparing for, weakening the confidence and scale of her forecast.

findings.highlight: it just screws up my plans if my ally dies!
findings.evidenceJa: かってに脱落されちゃ予定が狂う
findings.governingReading: Her plans suffer if a cooperation partner drops out or is eliminated on his own.
findings.explanation: mirror moon makes the outcome specifically death and replaces the negotiated relationship with generic allyship.

findings.highlight: I’m just making sure!
findings.evidenceJa: それだけの、ちょっとした確認事項っ！
findings.governingReading: It was only a small, trivial point of confirmation.
findings.explanation: The English retains defensive confirmation but loses Rin’s layered minimization.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka says so quickly.
findings.evidenceJa: があー、とまくし立てる。
findings.governingReading: Rin rattles the words off with a loud frustrated “gaaah.”
findings.explanation: Speed remains, but the comic vocal outburst disappears.

findings.highlight: I’m beginning to understand more about Tohsaka.
findings.evidenceJa: 普段クールな分判りやすい
findings.governingReading: Her embarrassment is especially easy to read precisely because she is normally cool.
findings.explanation: The English keeps Shirou’s growing familiarity but removes the contrast that enables it.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka looks away
findings.evidenceJa: ふん、と顔を背けて
findings.governingReading: Rin turns her face away with a dismissive hmph.
findings.explanation: The audible, defensive flourish is omitted again.

findings.highlight: Murmur something meaningless.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな、意味のない事を訊いていた。
findings.governingReading: Shirou finds himself asking that meaningless question.
findings.explanation: The English becomes an ungrammatical sentence fragment and changes asking into murmuring.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka looks back at me in wonder
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂ははあ？　と目を見開いて俺を見る。
findings.governingReading: Rin looks at him with eyes widened, blurting an incredulous “Huh?”
findings.explanation: The concrete surprised reaction becomes the vaguer and softer “wonder.”

findings.highlight: He’s a good guy even though he’s rebellious.
findings.evidenceJa: アイツ捻くれてるけどいいヤツ
findings.governingReading: Archer is twisted, contrary, or difficult, but a good person.
findings.explanation: “Rebellious” changes an ingrained crooked temperament into resistance to authority.

findings.highlight: He’s immature in spite of his looks
findings.evidenceJa: ああ見えても子供っぽいし
findings.governingReading: Despite appearances, Archer has a childlike side.
findings.explanation: “Immature” turns Rin’s fond, playful observation into a negative developmental judgment.

findings.highlight: disappears down the stairs.
findings.evidenceJa: 階段へ消えていった。
findings.governingReading: Rin goes ahead and disappears toward or into the stairway.
findings.explanation: The English adds a downward direction the source does not specify.
